INSERT INTO ENT_ANALYSIS_JOB_DETAILS ( JOB_SEQ , REFERENCE_ID , OSS_NAME , OSS_VERSION , LICENSE_NAME , DOWNLOAD_LOCATION , HOMEPAGE ) VALUES
( #{item.jobSeq}, #{item.referenceId}, #{item.ossName}, #{item.ossVersion}, #{item.licenseName}, #{item.downloadLocation}, #{item.homepage} )
mapper.update: UPDATE ENT_ANALYSIS_JOB EAJ INNER JOIN ( SELECT REFERENCE_ID, JOB_SEQ AS MAX_JOB_SEQ, SUM(CASE WHEN REFERENCE_OSS_ID IS NOT NULL AND REFERENCE_OSS_ID != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CALC_SUCCESS, SUM(CASE WHEN REFERENCE_OSS_ID IS NULL OR REFERENCE_OSS_ID = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CALC_FAILURE FROM ENT_ANALYSIS_JOB_DETAILS WHERE JOB_SEQ = #{jobSeq} GROUP BY JOB_SEQ ) CAL ON EAJ.JOB_SEQ = CAL.MAX_JOB_SEQ SET EAJ.SUCCESS_COUNT = CAL.CALC_SUCCESS, EAJ.FAILURE_COUNT = CAL.CALC_FAILURE
UPDATE ENT_ANALYSIS_JOB SET SUCCESS_COUNT = SUCCESS_COUNT + 1, FAILURE_COUNT = GREATEST(FAILURE_COUNT - 1, 0) WHERE JOB_SEQ = #{jobSeq} AND (SUCCESS_COUNT + 1) <= TOTAL_COUNT
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CNT), 0) AS CNT FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM OSS_VERSION WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CREATED_DATE, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') AND IFNULL(DIVISION, '') = #{division} GROUP BY DIVISION ) TBL
